functions.name: to_council_key
functions.input: Portal LGA name or former-council slug from the page
functions.output: council key string used in the DCP table queries
functions.if_none: None or blank input returns None, never an empty string

functions.name: _fetch_dcp_coverage
functions.input: raw council name and housing type
functions.output: coverage findings for the council, or None
functions.if_none: a None key returns None before any query runs

values.if_missing: no DCP rows fetched, footprint withheld with the existing message

queries.purpose: DCP setback rows for the council (existing query, normalised key)
queries.where_clause: lga = %s AND is_current AND not needs_review
queries.if_wrong: a wrong rename sends another council's rows: guarded by the rename list being one file with a test

break_it.scenario: TS and Python rename lists drift apart again
break_it.what_happens: the DCP tab and the yield box show different councils' rules
break_it.how: both read lga-slug-renames.json; test fails if the TS file regains an inline map

break_it.what_happens: WHERE lga='' reads back as this council has no controls
break_it.how: to_council_key returns None for blank or punctuation-only input
